```plato
//==
// # Color
//
// Sections, in order:
//  - Colors - color arithmetic
//  - Named colors - the 141 CSS Color Module Level 4 / X11 names

library Colors
{
    //==
    // # Colors - color arithmetic
    //
    // Implementation bodies for `Color` (`color.types.plato`): the `INumerical`
    // obligations (IAdditive, IScalable, IInterpolatable, INumericalLimits), computed
    // component-wise over R/G/B/A including alpha. The 141 CSS/X11 named colors
    // follow in the next section.

    //==
    // Color - the INumerical obligations, component-wise over R/G/B/A.
    //
    // Alpha participates in the arithmetic like any other component. That is the
    // right behaviour for a linear-light value type (it makes Lerp a straight
    // 4-vector interpolation), but it is NOT alpha compositing
    // (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Alpha_compositing): premultiplication and
    // Porter-Duff operators belong with the imaging package.

    // Component-wise sum, alpha included.
    Add(a: Color, b: Color): Color
        => (a.R + b.R, a.G + b.G, a.B + b.B, a.A + b.A);
```
